subject: Marketplace campaign match funding request
messages:
From: Alex Thompson <alex.thompson@cloudflow.co>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace co-campaign — request for partner match credits

Hi Ben,

Hope youre well. CloudFlow is gearing up for a Q3 marketplace push (launching a vertical marketplace listing + paid spotlight) and wed like Redwood to be a featured partner. As part of the go-to-market plan we budgeted partner match credits to support trial conversions and co-marketing offers.

High level ask: would Redwood consider providing promotional credits that mirror what CloudFlow is committing? Were proposing a 1:1 match up to $20k in credits, plus a 60-day trial extension for customers who come via the marketplace listing. The program includes a joint landing page, two co-branded webinars, and shared demand gen.

I attached a short proposal and estimated budget for the campaign (Attachment: CF-proposal.pdf, 220 KB).

Timing: marketplace listing goes live on July 20 — would love to lock in credits and messaging by July 10.

If helpful, happy to jump on a 20-minute call with you and Marissa to walk through the funnel assumptions.

Thanks,
Alex Thompson
Head of Partnerships, CloudFlow
alex.thompson@cloudflow.co
Attachment: CF-proposal.pdf (PDF, 220 KB)

Alex, thanks for the clear ask and the deck — this looks promising. Looping in Marissa (channel) to evaluate GTM alignment and Sergio (finance) to confirm budget/terms.

Quick answers/notes:
- Target is plausible; can we confirm whether the credits are purely promotional (no refunds) and whether they need per-customer caps?
- Well likely need a short contract addendum or DocuSign to capture the credit pool and usage rules.
- Internal ask: $20k is within range but we often propose a 60-day credit validity with a per-account cap (e.g., $2k/account) for marketplace-sourced customers. Marissa, Sergio  any immediate objections?

Propose next steps:
1) Marissa reviews the campaign plan and suggests final collateral/landing page copy.
2) Sergio confirms finance guardrails and deal id.
3) Ben to confirm external terms and send DocuSign link.

Onward,
Ben Carter
